mechanism: Both drugs can cause hepatotoxicity and affect hepatic metabolism; propylthiouracil may impair albendazole metabolism via CYP450 inhibition while albendazole may increase propylthiouracil levels.
action: Monitor liver function tests (AST, ALT, bilirubin) regularly; assess for signs of hepatotoxicity; consider alternative anthelmintic if possible or use with caution and close monitoring.
